logp.method_description: A 1:1 mixture of 1-octanol and PBS (1×, 0.01 M, pH 7.4) were mechanically shaken for 4 hours before allowing to stand overnight to pre-saturate the 1-octanol with PBS and the PBS with 1-octanol. Each phase was collected separately for use in the following LogD experiments. An unknown mass of each compound was suspended in 2 mL of 1-octanol and sonicated for 1 hour. The suspension was filtered through a 0.45 μm Durapore membrane and centrifuged (14,000 RCM, 5 minutes). A 1 mL aliquot of the supernatant was added to 1 mL of PBS. The samples were mixed for 5 minutes before standing for 30 minutes to complete partitioning. Aliquots of the 1-octanol (100 μL) were diluted to 500 μL in 1-octanol. PBS (500 μL) was added, and the samples mixed at 600 rpm on a BioSan Thermo-shaker TS-100 for 30 minutes. The samples were allowed to separate for 30 minutes. Aliquots of the 1-octanol and PBS layers (100 μL) were added to 1 mL and 900 μL of 35% HNO₃, respectively. Samples were left uncovered and heated to 95°C, shaking at 400 RPM for 60 minutes. 200 μL of aqueous layer in each digest were diluted to 2 mL with milliQ and analysed by ICP-MS. Average values of the copper content corrected by subtraction of the average copper content in the copper-free control. The ratio [Cu]org/[Cu]aq was calculated, and the base-10 logarithm taken.
